newsitem.title: UK: Psion rises as traders see stock oversold.
newsitem.headline: Psion rises as traders see stock oversold.

text.p: Shares in hand-held computer company Psion Plc rose for the fifth consecutive day this week as market players took the view that the stock had more room on the upside.
"It is a little bit oversold and there are a few buyers coming in," said one trader.
By 0900 GMT on Friday the stock was trading up 13-1/2p at 375p, levels not seen since early July.
Earlier in the week, the stock was boosted by press reports that the company's new Series 5 portable computer was in high demand.
The shares rose despite reports that Psion was failing to meet the demand and sales of earlier models were suffering as customers waited for the Series 5.

A gloomy mid-June trading update about the adverse affect of the strength of sterling, and that the performance of the group would be affected while it waited to establish the series 5 model, swiped 80p of the stock price.
Since then the shares fell gradually to the year's low of 275p on August 7 before rebounding to today's levels over this last week.
